Dome cameras are mounted on ceilings or wall brackets, with the camera housed inside a protective dome. Fixed models monitor a defined area, while pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) models can change their viewing direction and zoom.

Choose an indoor or outdoor model to suit the installation. Infrared illumination, weather resistance and vandal resistance depend on the selected model and its housing.

IP video servers convert video from analogue cameras into digital streams for transmission over a network. They help existing analogue surveillance systems connect to compatible IP monitoring and recording software.

Depending on the model and software, users can view live video, manage connected cameras and access recordings through authorised desktop or mobile applications. Remote viewing requires a suitable network connection and secure access configuration.

widgets.400fbb87:
Thermal cameras detect infrared radiation emitted by objects and convert it into an image. Differences in detected radiation make temperature patterns visible, including in darkness.

Thermal and optical cameras serve different purposes: thermal sensors reveal heat patterns, while visible-light sensors show scene detail. Combined systems can support perimeter monitoring and temperature-related alerts. Detection performance and temperature measurement capability depend on the camera model, lens, installation and environment.

Candid SekurZone is automatic number plate recognition software for vehicle access and monitoring. It reads a vehicle registration number from a compatible camera image and records the event with its time, location and associated vehicle images.

System configuration depends on the cameras, lane layout and software integration. Contact our team to confirm compatibility and the requirements for your installation.
